topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and introduces the session's focus on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition in Innate Immunity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular injury through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Initiation of the Inflammatory Response and Leukocyte Recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cells translate recognition signals into the mobilization of leukocytes, tissue trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation and govern subsequent tissue healing or chronic inflammatory outcomes.

topics.label: Closing and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
